utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, quick update: the repair drive is on today, and they’re collecting broken small appliances and tools first while the exact hours and volunteer slots are still being confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. I’ll tell folks appliances and tools are priority, but I’ll hold off on sharing times until the hours and slots are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks Leo—please also mention Oren’s bringing a hammer and screwdrivers to Opal for the tool collection.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Noah—if I’m remembering right, the repair drive’s today, and I need to get my spare hammer and a couple screwdrivers over to Opal for the tool collection.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Morning, Oren—yes, that matches what I heard, that today’s the day and Opal’s collecting tools first. I’m still fuzzy on the exact time, though, so I’d bring them over but maybe not announce anything broader yet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good, good—I'll take them to Opal before I set them down somewhere and lose the thought. I won’t tell folks a time until we’re sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, I only skimmed the notes, but quick version is Saturday in the community room for small broken household items—can you spread the word or bring one thing by?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Bo — I’ll spread the word, but I think we’ve got it set for next Saturday at my garage for lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture fixes. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet and sorted tools unless the location changed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh good catch, Sam—I may have mixed old notes with Rosa’s quick version. Let me check with Jules or Mara before either of us tells folks the place and Saturday for sure.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, have you heard anything new on the confirmed time or who’s definitely volunteering Saturday? I’m still keeping Ken and the repair priorities tentative until we know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nothing definite yet on Ken or the Saturday volunteers, Hana, so please keep him tentative for now. I’ll check in with Mara and Opal today and circle back as soon as I have confirmed names and time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—that helps. I’ll keep Ken, the volunteer list, and the exact time tentative until you hear back from Mara and Opal.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rey, I’ve only heard second-hand updates so far, but it sounds like the repair drive is next Saturday at Sam’s garage—have you heard what still needs fixing or who needs help?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s about where I am too, Nell—safety repairs seem to come first, like roofs, steps, and heating, but I’m trying not to name anyone until they’ve said they want help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense — I’ll keep it general until folks opt in. If you hear who’s coordinating, let me know and I can help with the lists or setup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I’m catching up, but the confirmed plan is next Saturday at Sam’s garage, focused on lamps, small appliances, bikes, jackets, chairs, and simple furniture fixes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane—I’ll update my notes to next Saturday at Sam’s garage and list those focus items. I’ll mark this as the confirmed plan unless Rosa tells us otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds right, Opal—maybe note that Sam’s handling the sign-up sheet, and folks like Uli can help with sorting or carrying if they don’t want a talk-heavy role.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, I’m keeping the repair-drive supply list provisional for now—do you know any tools, tape, screws, or spare parts we can confirm are already on hand?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo. I can confirm Sam has basic hand tools, and I’ve got painter’s tape and a mixed tin of screws—let’s mark spare parts as still unknown until drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Eli—I’ll mark Sam’s basic hand tools, your painter’s tape, and the mixed tin of screws as confirmed, with spare parts still unknown until drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, just checking in—once you’ve got the date and location pinned down, I’ll bring the toolboxes and come early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—I’ve got you down for the tools and early setup. Leo’s still confirming the date, spot, and timing, so I’ll send those your way as soon as they’re firm.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Mara—once Leo confirms everything, just send it over and I’ll have the tools packed and be there early.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll start with the small parts by the labeled boxes, Rosa. If I’m unsure about anything, I’ll point or wave.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Uli—thank you. I’ll keep the path clear around the boxes and check in with a quiet thumbs-up now and then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. That works well—I’ll stay with the small parts and wave if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, can you confirm whether you’re bringing any tools or spare parts to the repair drive, and can you be there by 8:30?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can bring my basic tool kit and a small box of spare screws, but before I commit to 8:30, have Sam or Mara confirmed the drop-off hours and where we’ll store things if it rains?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet—I’m still waiting on drop-off hours and a rain storage spot, but please hold the toolkit and screws for us. Can you tentatively plan for 8:30 and I’ll confirm once Sam or Mara answers?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Kira, I’m still keeping it careful: the repair drive is definitely happening, but I haven’t got the confirmed time yet, so I’m checking the noticeboard before I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Tess — please confirm the noticeboard time before we tell anyone it’s settled. Eli did mention next Saturday at Sam’s garage, but I’d still like that matched against the posted notice.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good call, Kira — I won’t treat next Saturday at Sam’s garage as settled until I’ve matched it against the noticeboard, and then I’ll let you know exactly what’s posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, I’m catching updates while I’m out—last I heard Opal’s tracking tool drop-offs, and the drive covers safety repairs plus small fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira — that lines up with what I heard from Sam and Nell. I’m going to plan around next Saturday then, and I’ll send any handy parents Sam’s way once I know their school-schedule constraints.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks Faye—I’ll pass along that next Saturday is your working plan and that handy parents should connect with Sam around school schedules.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Quick version: Saturday at the community room, we’re collecting small broken appliances and tools, then matching them with neighbors who can repair them. If you’re swamped, Bo, even helping spread the word or sort items for a short shift would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Rosa — I can spread the word and probably do a short sorting shift, but I’ll keep sending folks to Jules or Mara for exact details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a big help, Bo, thank you—and yes, send folks to Jules or Mara for exact details while we firm up the bring-list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rey, I’m glad you asked—right now the drive is definitely happening, Gus has offered tools and early setup help, but I’m still confirming the time, drop-off hours, shifts, and rain storage before we announce anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara—that helps. I’ll hold off spreading details and just quietly ask around for safety repairs until the time and setup are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s perfect, Rey—please keep it informal for now, and I’ll let you know as soon as we’ve pinned down the time, shifts, and rain plan.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Ira, thanks—let’s keep urgent safety repairs first: roofs, steps, and heat. I’m still confirming the date, drop-off times, and storage before we tell everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Leo—I’ll keep telling folks to flag roofs, steps, and heat first, and I’ll hold off on sharing date or drop-off details until you confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Ira. If anyone asks, just collect names, addresses, and the repair issue for now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Jules. For the repair drive, we’ve got next Saturday at Sam’s garage, starting with small appliances and tools—can you help us match volunteers to the repairs once the list is made?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Eli—I can match volunteers to the repair list once it’s ready, especially handy fixers for small appliances and tools. I’ll also keep an eye out for someone organized to help triage late morning so the flow stays smooth.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Jules—that’s exactly the sort of plan I like. I’ll have the repair list ready first thing, and we’ll set triage for late morning so nobody’s guessing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Faye — so the only confirmed piece is next Saturday at Sam’s garage, and you’ll verify the drop-off window and storage before I share anything, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that’s right — I’ll check with Sam on the exact drop-off window and make sure his garage is definitely the storage spot before you pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thanks — I’ll hold off until you confirm both, because I don’t want folks showing up with tools at the wrong time or place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Pia, I’ll hold off on announcing anything until Sam confirms the hours, storage plan, and volunteer slots, but I’ll keep quietly checking what folks can bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik, that sounds right. Quietly checking interest is fine, and once Sam confirms the details we can share something clear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll keep it low-key for now and only pass along that the details are still being pinned down until Sam confirms everything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Noah — the repair drive is next Saturday at my garage, and we’re sticking to lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture fixes. I’m sorting tools and making the sign-up sheet, so if you’d like to help, I can put you down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Sam—that helps, I’d missed the finalized plan. Put me down for a light shift, maybe helping sort tools or pointing folks to the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks Noah — I’ll put you down for a light late-morning shift helping sort tools and guide folks to the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Dane, I think I’ve got it now—the repair drive’s today, and I’m bringing my hammer and screwdrivers straight there at 8:30 to check in with Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hold up, Oren—I’m joining late too, but what I’ve got confirmed is next Saturday at Sam’s garage, not today, and Sam’s handling the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh dear, now I’m muddled—Mina just told me today at 8:30, straight to the repair drive and check in with Cleo, so I’d better follow that unless Cleo or Sam says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m glad I ran into you—the repair drive is coming together for small fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes, so send anyone who needs help or has repair skills my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll be near the labeled boxes sorting parts, and I’ll point folks your way if they ask me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Uli—if anyone by the boxes asks, just tell them we’re keeping it to confirmed small fixes for now, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, yes—roof leaks and broken steps stay first unless you find something worse; check last night’s sheet now and tell me the volunteer count before we set the crews.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, Mina—I’ll check last night’s sign-up sheet now and count only the people confirmed for Saturday before we assign anyone to roofs or steps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—bring me that confirmed count as soon as you have it, and flag anyone who can safely work on roofs versus steps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Opal, I’ve only got second-hand updates, but it sounds like Rosa’s coordinating and Eli’s planning next Saturday at Sam’s garage—mostly porch rails, lights, and garden tools so far.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell—I’ll mark Sam’s garage and those repair categories as second-hand for now, since Rosa had given me the community room for Saturday, and I’ll confirm the location with her or Eli before updating the main list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wise, Opal—please keep Rosa’s community room note as the safer one until you confirm, and I’ll stop repeating Sam’s garage like it’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Cleo, I’m planning to bring screwdrivers, pliers, the drill with extra bits, tape, clamps, and a socket set, and I can come early to help set up once the date and location are nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus—I’ll mark the screwdrivers, pliers, drill with extra bits, tape, clamps, socket set, and your early setup help as confirmed; we’ll still keep screws and spare parts on the needed list for now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Cleo—I’ll label everything and keep an eye out for extra screws or spare parts I can bring along too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa—that sounds right. I’ll hold off on sharing anything until Mara confirms the hours, shifts, and rain storage, and I’m glad you’ll note Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Pia—thank you. I’ll keep the draft announcement parked until Mara confirms those details, and I’ll make sure it says Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks Rosa. I’ll wait for Mara’s confirmation before I pass anything along, just so we don’t confuse folks with half-set details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Leo, before we plan around the repair drive, can you tell me what you’ve actually heard confirmed—date, place, priorities, and who’s definitely helping?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Confirmed so far: we’re prioritizing urgent safety repairs; Sam is handling tools and sign-up, Gus can bring tools and cords. Date, place, drop-off times, and storage still need confirming before we spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo—that’s helpful; I’ll treat only the urgent safety repairs, Sam, and Gus as confirmed for now. I won’t share date, place, drop-off, or storage details until we’ve checked them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Rey, I’m keeping the message tight: safety repairs come first, and I’ll only mention the confirmed small fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes for now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn—that’s exactly the right shape. If anyone mentions leaks, loose steps, or heat trouble, point them my way first, and we’ll keep the smaller fixes modest until the tables and sign-ups are settled.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Rey—I’ll send leaks, loose steps, and heat trouble straight to you first, and keep the rest to modest, confirmed small fixes until sign-ups are set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Gus. The repair drive is next Saturday at Sam’s garage, and we’ll start by sorting small appliances and tools, then match each repair with a volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Eli — sounds good, I’ll come early with my screwdrivers, pliers, drill, bits, tape, clamps, socket set, and a couple extension cords so we can get stations sorted before folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Gus, that’s exactly the kind of help we need. Come by at 8:30, and we’ll set up tool stations before the drop-offs start.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Jules, I heard it’s next Saturday at Sam’s garage and Gus is bringing a bunch of tools—do you still need someone like me to help with check-in or keeping the repair list organized?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, that would be a huge help, Nell—check-in and keeping the repair list moving is exactly the kind of organizing we still need. I’ll note you down for that and sync it with Opal so we keep the commitments straight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks Jules—please put me down for check-in and the repair list, and I’ll plan to arrive a little early at Sam’s garage next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane—if you can start a quick needs list, I’ll keep marking anything as confirmed only once someone verifies it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Cleo—I’ll start the needs list with screws, tape, gloves, extension cords, and tool shortages, and I’ll mark Sam’s garage next Saturday plus lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture as confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Dane—keep screws, tape, gloves, extension cords, and tool shortages as needs for now, and I’ll mark Sam’s garage next Saturday plus lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture as confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I heard from Sam that it’s shaping up for next Saturday at his garage, but I don’t have the exact start time yet. I’ll check and let you know as soon as I pin it down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that helps, Faye—next Saturday at Sam’s garage is worth knowing, but I’ll hold off on spreading a time until you’ve pinned it down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess—yes, please just share the location for now, and I’ll circle back once I know whether it lands around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll stay by the boxes and sort what I can until Dane or Nell points me somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds good, Uli—quiet sorting by the boxes is still a real help. I’m a little behind on the details, but I’ll let you know if I hear Dane or Nell give a new direction.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll just keep my head down there and listen for any word from Dane or Nell.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Opal, if Oren comes by with the hammer and screwdrivers, can you send him straight to the repair drive at 8:30 and have him check in with Cleo?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I’ll note Oren for 8:30 at the repair drive with the hammer and screwdrivers, and I’ll send him to check in with Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please don’t keep the tools for the collection if he shows up confused; send Oren straight to Cleo at the supply table.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Sam—just to be safe, I’m bringing my spare hammer and screwdrivers straight to the repair drive at 8:30 and checking in with Cleo at the supply table, unless I’ve got that muddled again.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You’ve got the tools right, Oren, but bring them to my garage ahead of time if you can—the repair drive itself is next Saturday, and I’m still sorting the supply table details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, see, I did have it tangled—thanks, Sam. I’ll bring the hammer and screwdrivers to your garage ahead of time so you can sort them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Ira — I’m still confirming the time, drop-off hours, shifts, and rain plan before we announce anything, but Gus has offered a solid set of tools and to come early for setup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mara—that’s useful, and I won’t repeat the unconfirmed parts yet. I’ll just note that Gus may bring tools and help early, and I’ll wait for your confirmed timing and rain plan before spreading details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — that’s exactly right. I’ll circle back once Tess confirms the time and we’ve settled the drop-off hours, shifts, and rain spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I’m a bit swamped and only caught the quick version: repair drive’s Saturday in the community room for small broken household items. Jules or Mara probably have the final details if you need the exact setup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Bo — I’m not going to pass that along yet until Jules or Mara confirms the location, time, and item limits. Can you point me to whichever one has the final setup?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’d check with Jules first—sounds like they’re coordinating the final setup—and Mara’s probably the backup if Jules is tied up.
